title: fix(layout): a navigation group opens unless it declares otherwise (objectui#13336)
body:
Closes #13336
Clause-②: no
Ruling-ref: 6364601849

## Root cause

The collapse was not in the console sidebar. `@object-ui/layout`'s `NavigationRenderer` group row computed its initial open state as: open when the group holds the active route; else the declared `expanded` / `defaultOpen`; else **closed when the group has `AUTO_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD` (8) or more children**. Setup's Configuration group has 13 children and declares no `expanded`, so it started collapsed beside Advanced, the only group that declares `expanded: false`. Studio's navigation preview (`StudioDesignSurface` `NavTreeGroup`) carried a second copy of the same rule (`NAV_GROUP_AUTO_COLLAPSE`).

## What changed (ruling A, objectui half)

- `NavigationRenderer`: the count rule is gone. Initial open state is: a group holding the active route opens; else its declared `expanded` (spec) or `defaultOpen` (legacy) decides; else it opens.
- `StudioDesignSurface` `NavTreeGroup`: `NAV_GROUP_AUTO_COLLAPSE` is removed the same way, and its docblock is reworded, so the preview still opens groups as the running sidebar does.
- Comment-only rewording where the old heuristic was explained: the home Administration group in `UnifiedSidebar` (objectui#3609; its explicit `expanded: true` is kept), the matching comment in `systemNavSettingsTarget.test.tsx`, and the bar-specific list in `AppSchemaRenderer.mobileTabOrder-11395.test.tsx`.
- One changeset: `@object-ui/layout` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, patch. It tells an app that relied on a long undeclared group starting closed to declare `expanded: false`.

**Not done here:** the spec default. objectstack `GroupNavItemSchema.expanded` declares `.default(false)` in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`. That belongs to the spec lane and was requested on objectstack#6017 (comment 6364612240). The served nav does not apply that default on the wire today (only Advanced arrives with `expanded: false`), so objectui now reads an absent `expanded` as open.

## Tests

- New `NavigationRenderer.groupDefaultOpen-13336.test.tsx` (layout): an undeclared 13-child group opens with every child linked; `expanded: false` stays collapsed; legacy `defaultOpen: false` stays collapsed; a declared-closed group holding the active route opens.
- New `UnifiedSidebar.groupDefaultOpen-13336.test.tsx` (app-shell, real `NavigationRenderer`): an undeclared 13-entry group opens with every entry linked; `expanded: false` stays collapsed; the active-route override opens it.
- Reverse check: with `NavigationRenderer.tsx` restored to the base commit, the two "undeclared 13-child group opens" cases fail (2 failed, 5 passed); with the fix, all 7 pass.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/layout/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/systemNavSettingsTarget.test.tsx`: 62 files, 450 tests passed.
- `StudioDesignSurface` nav-tree tests (the 14 `StudioDesignSurface.*nav*` / `*Nav*` files, `interfacesNavTree-12455` among them): 116 tests passed. The full `StudioDesignSurface*` set was not run locally: two attempts through the shared verify lock timed out in the queue. CI runs it.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/layout --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 31 of 31 tasks successful.
- ESLint on the touched files: 0 errors (existing warnings only). `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major` pass; `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new citations.

## Acceptance notes

- No test pinned the old count rule, and no other copy of the threshold exists under `packages/layout/src` or `packages/app-shell/src`.
- Studio's preview has no dedicated pin for an undeclared long group. Its test files were outside the declared file surface, so none was added.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
